claims.head: Special teams tilt toward Edmonton
claims.body: Edmonton ranks 1st of 32 on the power play (9.7 expected goals per 60); Seattle ranks 29th on the penalty kill.

claims.head: Seattle pounces on mistakes, and Edmonton makes them
claims.body: Seattle ranks 10th of 32 for chances off turnovers (7.5% of its chances come right after winning the puck); Edmonton ranks 29th for avoiding breakdowns.

EDM.head: Edmonton has nearly everything going for it
EDM.body: Edmonton has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Anything short of a win would be a surprise, though Seattle can make a game of it if it pounces on loose pucks.

SEA.head: Seattle has its work cut out
SEA.body: Edmonton has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Seattle’s best hope is pouncing on loose pucks, plus a big night in goal.
